local function GetNil(Name, DebugId)
	for _, Object in getnilinstances() do
		if Object.Name == Name and Object:GetDebugId() == DebugId then
			return Object
		end
	end
end

local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Functions.SellTower
Event:InvokeServer(
    GetNil("Freddy Trashcan", "1_126184")
)
